classifications.rationale: The President assigns the Secretary a personal approval role and limits the pilot's organizational deployment; this is internal executive supervision of a discretionary program, not a present change in legal rights or a command to impose a specified later legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: you must personally approve the creation and implementation of any pilot program

classifications.rationale: The President requires the Secretary to make a specified opt-out right a term of any later-administered pilot program, dictating the legal consequence the agency must provide to participating complainants.
classifications.evidence: the pilot programs provide that complaining parties may opt out of participation in the pilot programs at any time

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Secretary to report an assessment and supporting data to the EEOC after the pilot period; this is an internal reporting requirement, while the remaining sentence merely explains the directive's purpose.
classifications.evidence: submit an assessment of the pilot programs, together with the relevant underlying data, to the EEOC
